verdict.rationale: The axis applies because 2FAS mentions a '2FAS API' for service integration, but the evidence shows no interactive API reference or runnable examples. All OpenAPI/Swagger paths returned 404, and the site's llms.txt declares 'Public API: None'. Its agent-friendly docs (llms.txt, .md mirrors) are adjacent features and earn no credit for an interactive API explorer.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
